Transient socket faults back off while protocol timers continue
Fatal errors/crash use SCM recovery; ordinary Stop stays stopped

sections.title: 05 / BfdWinService • the packet garden
sections.kicker: LocalService + restricted BFD service SID • only SeChangeNotifyPrivilege • one mutable engine owner

items.title: UDP transport
items.body:
Exclusive sockets; stable 49152–65535 source
Ancillary destination, interface, TTL/hop limit
Event-driven receive / stop / settings waits

items.title: Path acceptance
items.body:
Firewall is a separate kernel gate
Peer / point-to-point, port, destination & interface
Single-hop TTL=255; optional MinTtl elsewhere

items.title: Wire packet & auth
items.body:
Header, length, flags and discriminators
None, password, meticulous MD5, keyed/meticulous SHA-1
Digest/replay checks precede state updates

items.title: Classical BFD
items.body:
One asynchronous single-/multihop session
Down → Init → Up; passive & Demand handling
Poll/Final, learned discriminator & diagnostics

items.title: S-BFD initiator
items.body:
Provisioned remote discriminator; direct Up
Bounded outstanding probes + reply correlation
Replay/expiry checks and anycast sources

items.title: S-BFD reflector
items.body:
One stateless listener, many initiators
Demand/loop checks; reverse discriminator pair
Sequence reflection + bounded per-source replies

items.title: Timer & work scheduler
items.body:
Negotiated TX/RX, jitter, detection expiry
Poll timing, suppression & congestion backoff
Reuse waits; bound receive and event work

items.title: Single-owner engine
items.body:
Selected protocol role owns accepted state
Run receive, expiry, transmission & transitions
Fan out observations and optional BGP actions

items.title: Transmit & socket recovery
items.body:
Prepare → send → commit only on success
Failed send keeps sequence/Poll/probe uncommitted
Receive/wait recovery uses 10–250 ms backoff

items.title: Settings updates
items.body:
Registry notification reloads S-BFD timing
Reflector maintenance changes Up/AdminDown
Startup role, key & BGP target need restart

items.title: Immutable telemetry
items.body:
Coherent ArcSwap snapshots; no reader lock
100 ms change spacing / 1 s refresh target
Counters publish on existing engine wakes

items.title: BGP policy & mailbox
items.body:
Optional; first Up enables Get / Start-if-stopped
Later Down → Stop; AdminDown releases own Stop
Bounded latest Stop/Start pair; worker off engine

items.title: Engine shutdown
items.body:
Invalidate status observer immediately
Role-permitted AdminDown announcements
Release own BGP Stop; finish bounded final action

items.title: Bounded diagnostics
items.body:
Lifecycle, communication, state, auth & errors
Background writer → ETW + optional file
UTC lines; 64 MiB rotation + one backup

items.title: Status RPC server
items.body:
Read-only GetSessionStatusV1
Authorize broker; copy one fixed snapshot
No packet-loop query; unregister and drain

items.title: Binding & server identity
items.body:
ncalrpc only; WINNT + packet privacy
Static Identify/effective-only credentials
V5 pins exact account AND service SID

items.title: Endpoint & caller authorization
items.body:
Protected service-SID ACLs
Every call: actual transport/auth + exact account
Enabled service SID through Authz; no impersonation

items.title: Native ownership & deadlines
items.body:
Bounded records, admission and real async deadlines
Cancel/complete before freeing native call storage
Deny runtime management; no reverse RPC callbacks

items.title: BGP control → broker
items.body:
BFD initiates Get / Start / Stop
BfdWinService.Bgp.v2 • BgpControl 2.0
Request carries no caller-selected target

items.title: Session status → BFD
items.body:
Broker initiates GetSessionStatusV1
BfdWinService.Local.v2 • BfdLocal 2.0
Replies return on the same initiated call

items.title: Broker COM/MI host
items.body:
Verify own SCM-issued identity

Provider runs as broker, without caller token

items.title: Protected fixed target
items.body:
Read configured peer + routing domain
Get / Start / Stop are the only operations
No public COM class factory or UDP listener

items.title: Native MI provider worker
items.body:
Serialized local PS_BgpPeer requests
Get / Start / Stop through MI + COM
Provider identity stays the reduced SYSTEM token

items.title: Checked provider outcomes
items.body:
Reject unknown/ambiguous connectivity
Start/Stop require success and peer read-back
Cancellation cannot undo an executed operation

items.title: Bounded dispatcher
items.body:
One admitted control manager + one queued request
Discard cancelled/expired work before execution
Idle waits on request/stop events

items.title: Provider watchdog
items.body:
20 s active request supervision
Crash exit → SCM restart after 5 s
Pending failure retries; completed action not replayed

items.title: BGP control server
items.body:
Authorize LocalService + BFD service SID
Accept fixed operations for protected target
RPC disconnect alone never changes the peer

items.title: Broker stop & diagnostics
items.body:
Stop provider/telemetry supervision
Retain unfinished native call storage
Own background ETW writer; 60 s stop budget

items.title: In-process telemetry worker
items.body:

2 s bind / 2 s call / 8 s supervision
One stalled worker is retained and quarantined

items.title: Checked observational cache
items.body:
Validate complete record and freshness
Unavailable/invalid/stale → no fabricated state
Cache never drives BGP; provider stays independent

This project supplies local management
